company.name: Northstar Builders
company.brandTagline: Schools, libraries and civic buildings, built while the doors stay open.

publicSite.capabilitySummary: General contracting, preconstruction and design-build for schools, libraries and community buildings across Central Ohio, with phasing plans that keep occupied campuses running. Northstar Builders is a fictional sample company.
publicSite.privacyNotice: We use the details you send only to review your request and reply to you. This is a fictional sample workspace, so requests are not sent to a real contractor.

services.name: General contracting
services.summary: Full-scope construction management for public and institutional buildings, from mobilization to closeout.
services.details: One accountable team for subcontractor coordination, schedule control, site safety, quality inspections and closeout documentation.

services.name: Preconstruction and estimating
services.summary: Early budgets, constructability reviews and phasing plans before the design is final.
services.details: Conceptual and detailed estimates, value analysis, logistics plans and bid packaging that keep scope, cost and schedule aligned.

services.name: Design-build
services.summary: A single contract for design and construction, with the architect and builder working from the first sketch.
services.details: Shared budget targets, faster decisions and one point of responsibility for owners who want fewer handoffs.

services.name: Occupied campus renovation
services.summary: Renovations and additions phased around classes, patrons and staff who stay in the building.
services.details: After-hours work windows, dust and noise controls, temporary egress and weekly coordination with facility staff.

portfolio.title: Maple Grove Elementary Addition
portfolio.summary: A twelve-classroom addition and new media center built on an operating elementary school campus.
portfolio.description: Two-story steel-frame addition with a secure entry vestibule, media center and outdoor learning courtyard, phased over two summers so classes never moved off site.
portfolio.approvedOutcome: Opened on schedule for the first day of school.

portfolio.title: Riverside Branch Library Renovation
portfolio.summary: Full interior renovation of a 1970s branch library with new reading rooms, study spaces and accessible restrooms.
portfolio.description: Mechanical and electrical replacement, new daylighting and an accessible entrance plaza, delivered while a temporary branch served patrons nearby.
portfolio.approvedOutcome: Reopened two weeks ahead of the planned date.

portfolio.title: Franklin Township Fire Station 4
portfolio.summary: A new three-bay fire station with living quarters, training room and decontamination area.
portfolio.description: Pre-engineered apparatus bays paired with a masonry living wing, built to keep the existing station in service until the move-in day.
portfolio.approvedOutcome: Station crews moved in without a gap in coverage.

project.name: Civic Learning Center
project.description: Occupied-campus expansion with a public library, flexible classrooms, and site improvements.
project.publicSummary: A new community learning center with a public library, flexible classrooms and meeting rooms, built beside an occupied campus.
